# ModelExpress

Project instructions for all AI coding agents live in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root. Read that file and follow it in full. It covers coding standards, build and test commands, pre-commit hooks, the procedures for adding CLI arguments and gRPC services, the version-bump procedure, commit sign-off (DCO) requirements, and which docs to update. Step-by-step procedures are in `.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`; `AGENTS.md` lists which to read for which task.

Do not add rules here. This file exists only because Copilot Chat looks for it; the Copilot coding agent reads `AGENTS.md` directly.
